520:t_2:55.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「So I, too, will open my heart and reveal my true intent, in order to secure your cooperation.」

520:t_2:57.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「So there's one here too who doesn't know how to speak properly.」

520:t_2:58.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Enough, $$アンジェロ$$. They must be on edge right now.」

520:t_2:59.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「First, rest from your long journey. The talks will be in six hours.」

520:t_2:60.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Understood. Until then, we will detain the members of $c.」

520:t_2:61.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Treat them with the utmost courtesy, mind you.」

520:t_2:63.en:
$$ブライト$$
「For now, we have no choice but to follow their instructions.」

520:t_2:64.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That's fine. So you've finally understood your position.」

520:t_2:65.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I thank you for answering my call, Captain.」

520:t_2:67.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You had provided information several times before, but were you waiting for a decisive opportunity?」

520:t_2:69.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Or perhaps you could not make up your mind somewhere, and the decision was put off until today...」

520:t_2:71.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Did it become futile, I wonder... Clinging forever to a grudge that can never be settled grew futile, and you dreamed of another possibility...」

520:t_2:72.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「What made you do so was the light of human hearts that enveloped $$アクシズ$$ - $c and that boy, $$バナージ・リンクス$$... Or perhaps Lieutenant $$マリーダ$$...」

520:t_2:73.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...It's true that what we carry is not a grudge that can ever be settled. But 'futile' isn't quite it...」

520:t_2:74.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I think I was simply tired... Tired of the self that gave up on everything and crouched in the dark...」

520:t_2:75.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「That person, too... and $$シャア・アズナブル$$, who wished to open the $$ニュータイプ$$ world his father dreamed of rather than take revenge on the $$ザビ家$$...」

520:t_2:76.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I can't help thinking they were in the same state of mind as I am now...」

520:t_2:78.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The only thing certain is that with this, events will flow in a better direction. I thank you for your cooperation, Captain.」

520:t_2:83.en: ～ $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ Medical Facility ～

520:t_2:85.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This is the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

520:t_2:86.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I see... So I had been asleep ever since we were on our way back...」

520:t_2:89.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ is currently occupied by $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

520:t_2:90.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...So the Master guided them in...」

520:t_2:92.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I had no proof... And I wanted to believe in the Master...」

520:t_2:93.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That brought about a result that can't be undone... I'm sorry...」

520:t_2:94.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Don't blame yourself, $$マリーダ$$... I'm the same.」

520:t_2:96.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I've fought in the $$ユニコーン$$ until today, but maybe all of it was for nothing...」

520:t_2:97.en:
$$バナージ$$
「When I think that if I had meekly handed the Box over to $$ネオ・ジオン$$, the fighting would have ended in one form or another, and the world might have been at peace...」

520:t_2:99.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...'But,' 'even so'... Everything I did thinking that backfires... No matter how hard I struggle, it's already...」

520:t_2:101.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But thanks to that, I am talking with you like this now...」

520:t_2:103.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「The way you feel is not wrong.」

520:t_2:104.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Believe in the possibility within you... and give your all to what you feel must be done.」

520:t_2:105.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Those words are not a curse. The one who passed them to you must have lived that way too. With no certainty, simply believing it was for the best.」

520:t_2:106.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But... that's irresponsible. Not even seeing it through themselves...」

520:t_2:108.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But even so... To be entrusted to someone who was not a stranger was the greatest blessing.」

520:t_2:109.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「This must be how the world moves forward, little by little. If we don't give up, aren't bound, and keep holding on to hope.」

520:t_2:111.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「The chance will surely come. When it does, don't hesitate - board the $$ガンダム$$.」

520:t_2:116.en: ～ $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ Briefing Room ～

520:t_2:117.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I am glad that we can meet face to face and talk like this, everyone.」

520:t_2:120.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「First, allow me to introduce myself again. I am $$フル・フロンタル$$, Leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

520:t_2:123.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「What do you intend to do by gathering us, $$フロンタル$$?」

520:t_2:124.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「As I said at the dock. I wish to request the cooperation of every one of you, including those who have defected from $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

520:t_2:125.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You really mean to join hands with us?」

520:t_2:126.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Exactly. For that, I want you to know what I am aiming for.」

520:t_2:127.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「And that hope extends to him as well.」

520:t_2:128.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Enter, $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

520:t_2:131.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ハマーン$$... To think we would meet again like this.」

520:t_2:132.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「How pitiful. So in the end you suffered the disgrace of captivity.」

520:t_2:133.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is not so, $$ハマーン$$. He is someone who could become the one who understands me best.」

520:t_2:134.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Which is precisely why I wish to speak my true intent here, where $c is, the place that keeps him far from being $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

520:t_2:135.en:
$$シャア$$
「So that is the resolution you spoke of...」

520:t_2:136.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Very well, Colonel $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

520:t_2:138.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Even if you obtained $$ラプラスの箱$$, I don't believe you would aim to rebuild $$ジオン$$ under the Empire.」

520:t_2:139.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Here and now, I will have you tell me what you truly think.」
